title: Does the TikTok Feed Lean Right? Exposure to Political Content Among Non-Partisan Users in Germany
abstract_excerpt: We evaluated disparities in exposure to partisan content among new, nonpartisan TikTok users. We performed a sock puppet audit using 118 automated users in Germany ahead of three regional elections in 2024 and the federal election in 2025 (N = 266.161 videos). The design allowed us to account for past individual user behavior, user networks, location, and time. Overall, general political content constitutes 5%–7% of nonpolitical user feeds in…
title_zh: TikTok Feed 的倾向正确吗？德国无党派用户接触政治内容的情况
abstract_excerpt_zh: We evaluated disparities in exposure to partisan content among new, nonpartisan TikTok users.在 2024 年三场地区选举和 2025 年联邦选举之前，我们使用德国的 118 个自动用户进行了袜子傀儡审计（N = 266.161 个视频）。 The design allowed us to account for past individual user behavior, user networks, location, and time. title: From Facebook to front page: the influence of the Gilets Jaunes’ social media on local press language and framing
abstract_excerpt: This article examines how social media discussions within a protest movement intersect with local news coverage, focusing on the French Gilets Jaunes in the Var department. We hypothesize that journalistic language may progressively align with activists’ semantic universe, thereby contributing to the diffusion of movement claims and terminology. We analyze activists’ Facebook discussions and reporting by the regional daily Var-Matin between…
title_zh: 从 Facebook 到头版：黄马甲社交媒体对当地媒体语言和框架的影响
abstract_excerpt_zh: 本文探讨了抗议运动中的社交媒体讨论如何与当地新闻报道相交叉，重点关注瓦尔省的法国黄马甲运动。我们假设新闻语言可能逐渐与活动家的语义世界保持一致，从而有助于运动主张和术语的传播。我们分析了活动人士在 Facebook 上的讨论以及地区日报 Var-Matin 的报道……

title: Whose voices and which effects? A scoping review of migration and social media effects
abstract_excerpt: Social media plays a central role in shaping migration experiences and public perceptions of migration. However, despite growing research activity, no systematic overview exists on how social media effects are examined across host and migrant populations. This scoping review synthesizes 65 empirical studies on social media effects in the context of migration published between 2020 and 2025. Guided by the differential susceptibility to media…
title_zh: 谁的声音以及哪些效果？移民和社交媒体影响的范围审查
abstract_excerpt_zh: 社交媒体在塑造移民体验和公众对移民的看法方面发挥着核心作用。然而，尽管研究活动不断增加，但对于如何研究社交媒体对东道国人口和移民人口的影响还没有系统的概述。这份范围界定审查综合了 2020 年至 2025 年间发表的关于移民背景下社交媒体影响的 65 项实证研究。以对媒体的不同敏感性为指导……

title: Claiming sociodigital futures? Knowledge practices and their consequences
abstract_excerpt: There is currently intense and widespread speculation about the implications of digital technologies for future societies, despite a wealth of evidence that past claims to predict how technology will shape the future have usually failed. Nonetheless, it is now well established that claims to knowledge about how emerging technologies will shape future worlds are performative, exercising powerful effects on the futures they claim to describe…
title_zh: 声称社会数字未来？知识实践及其后果
abstract_excerpt_zh: 尽管有大量证据表明过去预测技术将如何塑造未来的说法通常都失败了，但目前人们对数字技术对未来社会的影响存在着激烈而广泛的猜测。尽管如此，现在已经确定的是，声称了解新兴技术将如何塑造未来世界的知识是表演性的，对他们声称描述的未来产生强大的影响……

title: When Populism? Consistent and Opportunistic Populist Communication in the 2022 Brazilian Presidential Elections
abstract_excerpt: When do presidential candidates use populist communication, and does its prevalence vary across policy domains? We address these questions using an original dataset of 11,885 tweets from nine Brazilian presidential candidates during the 2022 elections. title_zh: 什么时候民粹主义？ 2022 年巴西总统选举中持续的机会主义民粹主义沟通
abstract_excerpt_zh: 总统候选人何时使用民粹主义沟通？其流行程度在不同政策领域是否有所不同？我们使用包含 2022 年选举期间 9 名巴西总统候选人的 11,885 条推文的原始数据集来解决这些问题。借鉴观念方法，我们将民粹主义话语运作为人民中心主义和反精英主义的共现，用基于 BERT 的微调分类器进行测量，并分类……

title: Skewed toward uniformity? Investigating algorithmic stereotyping and amplification in AI-generated images
abstract_excerpt: As text-to-image generative artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly shapes visual communication, concerns are growing about its role in reproducing social stereotypes. While recent algorithm auditing studies have advanced our understanding of stereotypical AI-generated imagery, they have largely focused on a narrow set of stereotypes – primarily gender and race – overlooking more nuanced forms. title_zh: 倾向于统一？研究人工智能生成图像中的算法刻板和放大
abstract_excerpt_zh: 随着文本到图像的生成人工智能（AI）越来越多地塑造视觉传达，人们越来越担心它在再现社会刻板印象方面的作用。虽然最近的算法审计研究增进了我们对人工智能生成图像的刻板印象的理解，但它们主要集中在一组狭隘的刻板印象上——主要是性别和种族——而忽视了更微妙的形式。为了解决这一差距，我们的研究采用了……

title: From constituencies to audiences: lessons from Brazil about audience analytics in representative politics
abstract_excerpt: The pursuit of audiences is a key driver of the mediatization of politics, yet it remains unclear how parliamentarians carry out this task. Drawing on interviews with members of Brazil’s Congress, this study investigates how politicians incorporate audience analytics into their communication strategies. It introduces a conceptual framework of audience perception – distinguishing among loyalists, followers, and audience reservoirs – to explain…
title_zh: 从选区到受众：巴西关于代议政治中受众分析的经验教训
abstract_excerpt_zh: 对受众的追求是政治媒体化的关键驱动力，但目前尚不清楚议员如何执行这一任务。这项研究根据对巴西国会议员的采访，调查了政治家如何将受众分析纳入他们的沟通策略。它引入了受众感知的概念框架——区分忠诚者、追随者和受众群体——来解释……

title: Branding the invisible: Big Tech, naming submarine cables, and the politics of infrastructure (in)visibility
abstract_excerpt: Submarine cables have historically been invisible: buried, technical and obscured by conventions such as security and language including naming practises that prioritised function over storytelling. However, as Big Tech companies like Google have emerged as major cable investors, increasingly shifting from consortium to sole or private ownership, they have disrupted the cable industry in many ways. This paper demonstrates this disruption…
title_zh: 塑造无形的品牌：大型科技公司、命名海底电缆以及基础设施可见性的政治
abstract_excerpt_zh: 海底电缆在历史上一直是隐形的：埋藏的、技术性的，并且被安全和语言等惯例所掩盖，包括将功能优先于讲故事的命名实践。然而，随着谷歌等大型科技公司成为主要的有线电视投资者，越来越多地从财团转向独资或私人所有权，它们在很多方面扰乱了有线电视行业。本文展示了这种破坏……

title: From Words to Harm: Hate Speech and Societal Violence in U.S. Presidential Campaigns
abstract_excerpt: Political speeches are typically viewed as mobilizing democratic participation, yet research shows elite political rhetoric—particularly when it contains hate speech—may contribute to societal harm. Our study extends this line of research by investigating the association between hate speech and societal violence from a temporal perspective in the context of U.S. presidential campaigns. abstract_excerpt_zh: 政治演讲通常被视为动员民主参与，但研究表明，精英政治言论——尤其是当其中包含仇恨言论时——可能会造成社会危害。我们的研究通过从美国总统竞选背景下的时间角度调查仇恨言论与社会暴力之间的关联，扩展了这一研究方向。我们研究了仇恨言论的关联程度……

title: Gabriel Tarde’s Crowded Publics: Rediscovering the Work of a Forgotten Media Theorist
abstract_excerpt: Despite a revival of interest in the work of Gabriel Tarde, he remains an underappreciated, patchily translated, and often misrepresented thinker. title_zh: 加布里埃尔·塔德的《拥挤的公众》：重新发现一位被遗忘的媒体理论家的作品
abstract_excerpt_zh: 尽管人们对加布里埃尔·塔德的作品重新产生了兴趣，但他仍然是一位未被充分重视、翻译不完整且经常被歪曲的思想家。当他被提及时，通常被视为行动者网络理论的“鼻祖”，正如布鲁诺·拉图尔所声称的那样。作为媒体影响力中对话力量的倡导者，正如 Elihu Katz 所提倡的那样；或者作为比较理性公众与非理性人群的有用但不准确的引文。这…

title: From Hate Speech to Collective Action Intentions: The Role of Counter-Speech and Accuracy Cues Among Targeted Minorities
abstract_excerpt: Online hate speech targeting minority groups poses a significant social identity threat to those affected, often prompting coping strategies like out-group avoidance or derogation, which can harm intergroup relations in diverse societies. However, collective action as an empowering response has received limited attention in this context. title_zh: 从仇恨言论到集体行动意图：反言论和准确线索在目标少数群体中的作用
abstract_excerpt_zh: 针对少数群体的网络仇恨言论对受影响的人构成了重大的社会身份威胁，往往会促使人们采取回避或贬损外群体等应对策略，这可能会损害不同社会中的群体间关系。然而，集体行动作为一种赋权应对措施在这方面受到的关注有限。本研究借鉴集体行动的社会认同模型（SIMCA），探讨了这两种机制……

title: Taking artificial intelligence from the ‘priesthood’ and providing it as a service: a media-genealogical perspective on big tech’s AI platformisation
abstract_excerpt: Recently, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google have been positioning artificial intelligence as a utility that should be accessible to everyone. At the same time, they promote their cloud platforms as a means of ‘democratizing’ AI as they distribute easy-to-use AI services at scale. title_zh: 从“圣职”中获取人工智能并将其作为服务提供：从媒体谱系角度看待大型科技公司的人工智能平台化
abstract_excerpt_zh: 最近，亚马逊、微软和谷歌一直将人工智能定位为一种人人都可以使用的实用工具。与此同时，他们将云平台推广为人工智能“民主化”的一种手段，大规模分发易于使用的人工智能服务。在本文中，我提出了一种媒体谱系学方法，将这种“民主化”主张置于基础设施化和……的更广泛发展中。

title: Media Use for Strong and Weak Ties: A Configural Examination of Personal Media System and Well-Being
abstract_excerpt: Taking a configural approach to personal media use, this study examined how strong- and weak-tie media configuration relate to digital stress and well-being. Using a sample of 1,197 U.S. adults (analytic N = 1,143), we explored how media configuration attributes (size, density, and centralization by tie strength, and homogeneity) are associated with well-being, directly and indirectly through five dimensions of digital stress (overconnectivity…
title_zh: 强关系和弱关系的媒体使用：个人媒体系统和幸福感的配置检查

title: Afterword: the waning power of the fix
abstract_excerpt: This commentary offers some reflections on the ‘power of the fix' in cybersecurity and its wider implications for technological democracy. title_zh: 后记：修复的力量逐渐减弱

title: Digital responsibility, skills and environmental awareness for digital sustainability
abstract_excerpt: This study investigates how digital competencies and environmental awareness interact to shape eco-friendly digital practices, contributing to the field of digital sustainability. Drawing on a representative sample of adult internet users in the United Arab Emirates (N = 1016), it explores (H1) whether individual responsibility predicts environmentally conscious digital practices; (H2) whether environmental awareness moderates the effect of…
title_zh: 数字可持续发展的数字责任、技能和环境意识
abstract_excerpt_zh: 这项研究调查了数字能力和环境意识如何相互作用，以塑造生态友好的数字实践，为数字可持续发展领域做出贡献。利用阿拉伯联合酋长国成年互联网用户的代表性样本（N = 1016），它探讨了（H1）个人责任是否预示着环保意识的数字实践； (H2) 环境意识是否会调节……的影响

title: Guidance over guidelines? Unpacking the uses and concerns of generative AI in communication science
abstract_excerpt: The rapid adoption of generative Artificial Intelligence (genAI) tools has transformed research practices across communication science. As genAI tools (and most notetably large language models), made the generation of text, images, and other media content extremely easy, they can potentially disrupt the way science is conducted. Yet, their integration into academic workflows has outpaced systematic understanding of how, when, and why…
title_zh: 指导高于指导方针？解析生成式人工智能在通信科学中的用途和关注点
abstract_excerpt_zh: 生成人工智能（genAI）工具的快速采用改变了传播科学的研究实践。由于 genAI 工具（尤其是大型语言模型）使文本、图像和其他媒体内容的生成变得极其容易，因此它们可能会破坏科学的进行方式。然而，它们与学术工作流程的整合速度已经超过了对如何、何时以及为何……的系统理解。

abstract_excerpt: Feelings of irritation often emerge in romantic relationships. However, the theoretical mechanisms predicting whether individuals disclose these feelings to their romantic partner remain limited and largely reliant on examining indicators of future behavior rather than actual future behavior. title_zh: 预测浪漫关系中的恼怒披露：测试和扩展揭露风险模型
abstract_excerpt_zh: 恋爱关系中经常会出现恼怒的感觉。然而，预测个人是否向其浪漫伴侣透露这些感受的理论机制仍然有限，并且在很大程度上依赖于检查未来行为指标而不是实际的未来行为。当前的研究采用了一项涉及 448 名参与者的为期两个月的纵向调查设计，测试了启示风险模型 (RRM) 作为……的机制。

title: Democratic Media Performance and Democratization: A Global Longitudinal Perspective
abstract_excerpt: Media that effectively perform their democratic functions are widely considered a key driver of democratization, yet longitudinal evidence on their impact remains limited. This study analyzed global annual time-series data on democratic media performance and democratization from 1946 to 2018. title_zh: 民主媒体表现和民主化：全球纵向视角
abstract_excerpt_zh: 有效履行民主职能的媒体被广泛认为是民主化的关键驱动力，但其影响的纵向证据仍然有限。这项研究分析了 1946 年至 2018 年民主媒体绩效和民主化的全球年度时间序列数据。ARIMA 模型表明民主媒体绩效的年度增长与全球民主化的进步之间存在协变，衡量标准是……

title: Political Actors and Their Media Practices: Analyzing the Role of Media Participation in Democratic Backsliding and Resilience
abstract_excerpt: This paper draws together insights from political science and political communication to advance a new understanding of the role of media in democratic backsliding and resilience. The central argument is that all political actors may also be media actors, although they may do so anonymously or use false identities. abstract_excerpt_zh: 本文汇集了政治学和政治传播的见解，以推进对媒体在民主倒退和恢复力中的作用的新理解。核心论点是，所有政治行为者也可能是媒体行为者，尽管他们可能匿名或使用虚假身份。因此，大众对媒体的参与使得大众能够参与政治变革，从而带来更好或更坏的民主结果。作为…

title: The “Netflix Look”: Moving image aesthetics as data under platform logic
abstract_excerpt: This article examines Netflix’s industrial model through the framework of platform logic, arguing that the data-centric approach it adopts in the production of moving images alters the creative process. The result is a conceptual shift from shooting a film to capturing an image. Bridging platform studies and film theory, I build on David Bordwell’s poetics of cinema, which conceives the production process as a negotiation between institutional…

title: From platform outrage to institutional consequence: Convergent hybrid media accountability in Morocco
abstract_excerpt: This article develops the concept of convergent hybrid media accountability (CHMA) to explain how informal digital criticism is translated into institutional consequence in Morocco’s hybrid media environment. Moving beyond the view of accountability as an internal professional virtue, the article argues that where formal bodies are fragile or distrusted, citizens use platformed publics to initiate scrutiny from outside media institutions…
title_zh: 从平台愤怒到制度后果：摩洛哥的融合混合媒体问责制

title: How social media produces “Cheap Europe”: Digital Balkanism and the politics of creator mobility
abstract_excerpt: Digital platforms increasingly mediate how socioeconomic unevenness becomes visible, often recoding structural inequality as consumable value. This article introduces the concept of digital Balkanism to explain how platformed travel content reworks long-standing intra-European hierarchies. title_zh: 社交媒体如何产生“廉价欧洲”：数字巴尔干主义和创作者流动性政治

abstract_excerpt: This sequential, explanatory mixed-methods study explores how adult caregivers’ perceived family functioning and unresolved hurt toward siblings from childhood are associated with their present-day communal coping (CC) with their siblings and caregiving outcomes. title: Does Office Type Determine Gendered Campaign Messages?
abstract_excerpt: This study examines how candidates’ gender shapes campaign messaging across different branches and levels of political office. Prior research offers mixed evidence on whether women are more likely than men to emphasize communal traits and women-related policies, often because gender effects are examined without fully accounting for institutional context.
